name: Phil Zakharchenko
bio: Phil is an Apple platforms engineer obsessed with software craft and intentional design. At Apple, he worked on flagship macOS features including the modernized menu architecture, Window Tiling, and Stage Manager. In 2023, he joined Software Applications Incorporated as the first hire to build Sky, a reimagining of the Mac interaction paradigm. The company was acquired in 2025 by OpenAI, where Phil is continuing to build thoughtful experiences and dreaming up new interactions for Apple platforms.
